Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
Fixed the fashion accessory on login getting cancelled when switching characters with a destination (like /hw+ fc). The accessory is now equipped first, and the Lifestream trip waits a moment only if something actually had to be equipped. Plain logins work exactly as before.
Added an optional congestion queue timer under Client settings. It shows how long ago the queue started or last updated on the "server is currently congested" dialog, and once the refresh rate has been measured, counts down to the next update.
